sentences.text: Heard Shri Vidya Bhushan Soni, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Shri SS Baghel,
learned Dy GA for the State.
On 29.01.2025, this Court has directed the Superintendent of Police, Durg, to file his personal affidavit in the matter.

In compliance of the same, Superintendent of Police Durg has filed his personal affidavit on 01.02.2025, which is reproduced hereunder for ready reference:
1) It is respectfully submitted that the present petition filed by the petitioner under section 482 of CRPC for quashing of FIR dated 21/03/2023 by which the petitioner was made accused in the offense under section 420 read with section 34 of IPC to Crmp 349 of 2025 cheat once Mukesh Babne by creating forged documents of power of attorney and fake revenue documents/ Kisan Kitab (Rine Pustika)
2) That the petitioner has plead in his petition that he himself was under the impression that the concerned land belongs to Arvind Bhai he has himself perused the Khasra No B I, P II in that name of the Arvind Bhai was endorsed in this situation he has no intention to cheat Mukesh Bhabne and did not present any documents therefore, the ingredients of section 420 are not attracted against the applicant/petitioner.
3) That the matter was listed for hearing on 29/01/2025 at the motion stage before this Hon'ble Court.

This Hon'ble Court considering the matter and looking to the facts of the case directed the deponent to submit his personal affidavit as to, why the investigation has not been completed while the First Information Report was registered on 21/03/2023.

4) It is respectfully submitted that after the order of this Hon'ble court the deponent has issued show cause notice to the station officer incharge of police station Vaishali Nagar, on 30/01/2025 and sought clarification.

A copy of the show cause notice dated Crmp 349 of 2025 30/01/2025 is being filed herewith as Annexure A/1.
5) That the station officer police station Vaishali Nagar District Durg on the same N. Dhanraju vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179787633/
1 date submitted his explanation in writing with the explanation that crime No 61/2023 was being investigated Sub-Inspector Ghanshyam Singh Netam and he has not made any progress.

entities.text: N. Dhanraju vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, his explanation has been sought.
A copy of the letter seeking explanation of the investigation Officer is being filed herewith as Annexure A/2.

6) It is respectfully submitted that as the investigation has not concluded therefore,
the SHO has been directed to conclude the same within one month.
A copy of the order dated 31/01/2025 is being filed herewith as Annexure A/3.

We are pained to note that the manner in which present affidavit has been filed by the Superintendent of Police, Durg in very casual manner, though show-cause notice was issued to the Station House Officer concerned on 30.01.2025, who has submitted his explanation (Annexure-2).
Let the affidavit along with the Annexures be sent to the Director General of Police, Chhattisgarh,
who shall file his personal Crmp 349 of 2025 affidavit in the matter, to apprise this Court as to what action he proposes to take against the Investigating Officer, who does not know to file a Police report under Section 173(2) of the CrPC, where an accused is not appearing, or cooperating with the investigation, or is absconding.
Director General of Police, Chhattisgarh shall file his personal affidavit and an explanation also is called from the Superintendent of Police, Durg in this regard, by the next date of hearing.

Let the matter again be listed again on 25th February, 2025.
 Sd/- Sd/-
 (Ravindra Kumar Agrawal) (Ramesh Sinha)
